detail: sentence 1, "Take {{drug:m2}} {{dose:m1}}", names more than one MedicationRequest. A sentence with a dose, route, frequency, sig, or daily slot must match one of these shapes, with no other words and every slot naming the same order: Take {{drug:m2}} {{dose:m2}}. Take {{drug:m2}} {{route:m2}}. Take {{drug:m2}} {{frequency:m2}}. Take {{drug:m2}} {{sig:m2}}. Your dose of {{drug:m2}} is {{dose:m2}}. Your total of {{drug:m2}} is {{daily:m2}}. A daily total may also end: which is {{daily:m2}}.
